remarks: Spacious and meticulously maintained 1 bedroom corner unit (HEAT & HOT WATER INCLUDED!) in one of downtown Stamford's most prime locations. This open concept rental features a pristine kitchen with a breakfast bar flowing into the sunny living room, hardwood floors throughout, a large bedroom with a walk-in closet (HUGE!) and an ensuite full bath. Laundry in the building plus a private storage unit, too! With just steps to bars, restaurants, shopping, seasonal farmer's market and across the street from the Avon Theater it doesn't get any better than this! Garage parking is available just a couple of blocks away at the Bedford-Forest-Broad Street Garage for approximately $50/monthly. Do not miss out!
